q: aicoo, draft a PR description for adding dark mode toggle.
reply: 好的凯哥，我来draft dark mode toggle的PR description。先确认一下背景：这个PR是给dark mode phase 1的manual toggle feature，用户可以通过开关手动切换深色/浅色模式。基于Yuki的设计和Ravi团队的2 sprint实现。以下是draft：

## Summary
Add manual dark mode toggle to the application settings. Users can now switch between light and dark themes via a toggle in the user preferences panel.

## Background
- Dark mode beta feedback from 50 test users: 92% satisfaction rate
- User survey results: 82% prefer manual toggle over auto-switch
- Q4 roadmap item, phase 1 delivery target: mid-November
- Design approved by Yuki on Oct 19, handoff to engineering on Oct 20

## Changes
- New toggle UI component in Settings > Appearance
- Persistent preference saved to user profile (localStorage + backend)
- Applies dark theme CSS variables globally
- No impact on existing light mode behavior

## Testing
- Unit tests for toggle state management
- Visual regression tests for dark mode screens (login, dashboard, reports)
- Manual QA on Chrome, Firefox, Safari
- Verified no regression on pricing page (A/B test live since Nov 3)

## Future Work (phase 2)
- Auto-toggle based on system preference (planned for next sprint)
